$comment: Copy limits per marketing format. Word counts are rules of thumb drawn from the playbook (fewer words the faster it is read). Adjust to taste; the copy checker and future templates read these.

formats.name: Billboard / large outdoor
formats.notes: One idea, one image. CTA is a short URL or handle.

formats.name: Poster (A3, A2, 18x24 in)
formats.notes: Readable from 3 m. Details (date, place, URL) go in small type.

formats.name: Event poster
formats.notes: Details must include date, time and place.

formats.name: Instagram / LinkedIn post (on-image text)
formats.notes: The caption is separate; its first line (about 125 characters) shows before 'more'.

formats.name: Instagram / Facebook story, Reel cover
formats.notes: Keep text out of the top and bottom 250 px (interface overlays).

formats.name: Carousel slide
formats.notes: First slide is the hook; last slide carries the CTA.

formats.name: YouTube thumbnail
formats.notes: Three to five big words, maximum.

formats.name: Website hero section
formats.notes: Headline: what you offer. Subhead: how life gets better. Button: the next step.

formats.name: Flyer (A5, A4)
formats.notes: Use subheads to break body copy.

formats.name: Long-copy print ad
formats.notes: Image, headline, body, then logo and CTA. Caption every image.
